caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a semi-circular front and four short, turned legs. The cabinet is made of brown wood with visible grain patterns and features two rows of drawers at the top, each row containing two drawers with brass or gold-colored round handles. Below the drawers, there is a wide, vertically-ribbed or tambour-style door spanning the width of the cabinet’s front, with a small circular knob on the right side. The cabinet’s top, side panels, and legs are rendered in the same brown tones, and there is a thin, light border framing the entire image. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist’s signature appears in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Washstand
